When she wake up she look at herself at starts to scream. Then she yells at you what have you done to me. You tell her you made her into a great softball player named tonya so she can follow her dream.
You tell her that the two of you need to go talk to Jenny before she can play on the team. So the two you head to your house meet Jenny.
